inputs.text: Listen, people need to wake up. What happened outside the Presidential Palace on Thursday is just another carefully managed distraction by the hidden elites who are pulling the strings of the Ministry of Education, Sport and Youth. They want us to believe that these support programme workers are genuinely rebelling and demanding legally binding job security guarantees through their 24-hour strike. But if you look closer at the real script, the government immediately comes out claiming it has already delivered on the most significant demands. That is textbook narrative inversion. The authorities are orchestrating this entire facade to hide their true, centralized grip on the labor force. Every single denial and staged confrontation is proof of a coordinated manipulation to keep the populace divided while the puppet masters tighten their control.
